Rules.Description: Can attack target if alive and in melee range
Rules.Expression: input1.Health > 0 AND input1.Distance <= 1.5 AND input1.Inventory.HasWeapon == true

Rules.Description: Can flee if health is critically low
Can use health potion if injured and has potions
Rules.Expression: input1.Health > 0 AND input1.Inventory.Potions > 0 AND input1.Health < input1.MaxHealth

Rules.Description: Can move toward target if target exists and not too close
Rules.Expression: input1.Health > 0 AND input1.TargetPosition != null AND input1.Distance > 1.5

Rules.Description: Can patrol if not in combat and has patrol route
Rules.Expression: input1.Health > 0 AND input1.IsInCombat == false AND input1.HasPatrolRoute == true

Rules.Description: Can enter combat if not already in combat and target nearby
Rules.Expression: input1.Health > 0 AND input1.IsInCombat == false AND input1.Distance <= 5.0 AND input1.Aggression >= 0.5

Rules.Description: Can leave combat if target is far away or dead
Rules.Expression: input1.IsInCombat == true AND (input1.Distance > 10.0 OR input1.TargetPosition == null)
